subsystem.name: VehiclePhysicsSubsystem
subsystem.responsibility: Vehicle and wheel physics-side management: collision sub-lists, tracked vehicle instance lists, vehicle registry and config copy, per-frame vehicle update, player identity, wheel/particle render updates, wheel contact friction and particles, occupancy flags, lap-state writes, and state serialization.

summary: The vehicle_physics scope reconstructs 18 functions into a VehiclePhysicsSubsystem. CollisionObjectInsert manages four type-tagged collision sub-lists with free-list node reuse; BuildVehicleInstanceLists and SerializedStateExport maintain and serialize per-slot vehicle instance lists (104 slots, 18624-byte stride) and a range-sum section. A VehicleRegistry (basename lookup + random selection) and VehicleEntry deep-copy serve the vehicle configuration table. VehicleFrameUpdater runs the per-frame vehicle update (AI path, suspension, state machine, camera, climb adjust) and player-identity check via the global vehicle pointer table (dword_7C54F0 / dword_7C54E4). ParticleRenderObjectManager and WheelContactParticleSystem update wheel/particle render objects, friction, and contact particles gated by scoring time (dword_8AB6E4). OccupancyFlagBuilder reconciles a 52-entry flag array against live grid occupancy; LapStateWriter resolves and writes a lap/threshold value into a vehicle slot element. All roles are DERIVED/GUESS proposals; ownership is broadly UNKNOWN in the packet and several globals remain ungrounded.

function_roles.role: Insert a collision object into one of four type-tagged sub-lists after guard/validation, reusing a free-list node or allocating a fresh 12-byte entry.
Iterate 104 per-slot vehicle entries and build/refresh per-slot tracked-instance lists with identity dedup and session-time stamping.
Serialize object/vehicle state into a conditional dispatch stream including 104 slot-list entries and a trailing range-sum section.
Read the force/feedback dword at owner+0xF1C through the object handle at this+0.
Order and play a timed-audio event range, reset the audio ring buffer, scale endpoints into 40Hz buckets, and update vehicles on a bucket-boundary crossing.
Validate a vehicle-data accessor value in [6,8] when the type identifier is 2, else pass.
Look up a vehicle table entry by basename and cache the matched index (or 0) in dword_8AC38C.
Deep-copy vehicle configuration from a template entry into this entry (strings, identifier block, dwords, byte regions).
Select a random vehicle entry from a filtered candidate list using a 64-bit random state and bounds-checked indexing.
Per-frame vehicle update: substate reset, AI path tracking, suspension update, state-machine advance/clear, game-state branch, camera viewport/frustum, climb adjust.
Return whether this vehicle is the player by comparing this+0x4894 with the current player vehicle's +18580 slot.
Per-frame update of wheel render objects: expiry, position interpolation, direction placement, visibility vs player/AI, color/texture flag writes.
Per-frame particle physics: container init, lifetime selection, particle removal, velocity acceleration, AABB sliding collision, bounding-box render.
Spawn a wheel contact particle slot (capacity gate, circular-buffer slot, lifetime seed, quad vertices, wet/smoke alpha variant).
Compute wheel contact friction from the motion delta and spawn surface particles per contact slot with color/size packing.
Build a 52-entry vehicle occupancy bitmask from the live grid and reconcile a paired flag-field array against it.
Write this[9] (offset 0x24) into the caller-supplied destination at a2+16436 (0x4034).
Resolve an index from dword_8ACEE0 and apply the lap-state wrapper to the vehicle array element at 0x005EC6D8 + 18624*v2.

classes.name: CollisionObjectManager
classes.responsibility: Manages four type-tagged collision-object sub-lists (16-byte stride at this+0x70), a collision-node free list (dword_8AB700/dword_8AB708), and validated insertion of collision payloads.

classes.name: VehicleInstanceListBuilder
classes.responsibility: Builds per-slot lists of tracked vehicle instances, deduplicating by identity string, stamping session time onto new instances, and reusing entry nodes from a free list.

classes.name: SerializedStateExporter
classes.responsibility: Serializes object/vehicle state into a conditional dispatch stream: headers, two path strings, two byte flags, expected count, 104 slot-list entry streams, a byte flag, a linked list, then a range-sum (count, sum, span) section.

classes.name: ForceFeedbackOwner
classes.responsibility: Read-only accessor into an owning object that carries a force/feedback dword at +0xF1C.

classes.name: TimedAudioEventController
classes.responsibility: Orders a timed-audio event range into ascending endpoints, plays events, resets the audio ring buffer, re-scales endpoints into 40Hz buckets, and updates all vehicles when a bucket boundary is crossed.

classes.name: VehicleDataTypeValidator
classes.responsibility: Validates a vehicle-data value: when the type identifier is 2, fails unless the VehicleDataAccessor value lies in [6, 8].

classes.name: VehicleRegistry
classes.responsibility: Vehicle registry table access: basename lookup with matched-index cache and random selection from a filtered candidate list over the global table.

classes.name: VehicleEntry
classes.responsibility: Destination vehicle configuration entry filled by a deep template-to-entry copy (seven null-safe strings, identifier block, 15 dwords, byte-block regions, two trailing dwords).

classes.name: VehicleFrameUpdater
classes.responsibility: Per-frame vehicle update (substate reset, AI path tracking, suspension, state-machine advance/clear, game-state branch, camera viewport/frustum, climb adjust) and player-vehicle identity comparison.

classes.name: ParticleRenderObjectManager
classes.responsibility: Per-frame update of wheel render objects and particle effects: expiry, position interpolation, visibility/occlusion vs player or AI drivers, acceleration, AABB sliding collision, and color/texture flag writes.

classes.name: WheelContactParticleSystem
classes.responsibility: Computes wheel contact friction from motion deltas and spawns surface particles (tire spray/smoke/dust) with per-surface color/size packing and alpha scaling.

classes.name: OccupancyFlagBuilder
classes.responsibility: Builds a 52-entry vehicle-type occupancy bitmask from the live grid and reconciles a 52-entry paired flag-field array against it.

classes.name: LapStateWriter
classes.responsibility: Writes a lap/threshold value into a resolved vehicle-slot array element (18624-byte stride at 0x005EC6D8) via an index-resolver then a field store.

classes.name: SinglyLinkedNode
classes.responsibility: Generic singly-linked list node used by vehicle instance lists, serialization lists, and range-filtered lists: value pointer at +0, next at +4, optional 16-bit payload at +8.

classes.name: TrackedVehicleInstance
classes.responsibility: Per-vehicle tracked instance entry with identity string and session-time stamp fields written during list building.

state_machines.name: VehicleFrameStateMachine
transitions: Advanced -> Cleared on sub_4D1180 result != 0 via ObjectStateClear (0x004A5E80)
Cleared -> Advanced on sub_4D1180 result == 0 via StatePhaseSetter (0x004A5E60)

interfaces.name: SerializationSink
interfaces.purpose: Conditional dispatch stream primitive: initialize with a stream key and write raw dword/float/byte/string payloads.

interfaces.name: VehiclePointerTable
interfaces.purpose: Global active-vehicle pointer array (dword_7C54F0) with current-vehicle index (dword_7C54E4), player proximity entries (dword_7C54E0/dword_7C54DC) and vehicle count (dword_5C329C).

interfaces.name: VehicleRegistryTable
interfaces.purpose: Global vehicle registry table: entry count dword_8AC390, base dword_8AC394, 1060-byte stride, matched-index cache dword_8AC38C.

interfaces.name: ScoringTimeSource
interfaces.purpose: Elapsed-time resolution used by physics/render particles: scoring delegation when dword_8AB6E4==2 (via Delegation 0x004B9CE0), else session-time globals dbl_8AFEA0/dbl_8AFE98.

compatibility_contracts.name: VehicleSlotArrayLayout
compatibility_contracts.description: 104 per-slot vehicle entries each 18624 (0x48C0) bytes apart with array base 0x005EC6D8; per-slot instance lists are anchored at manager+0x44 and rebuilt by BuildVehicleInstanceLists.

compatibility_contracts.name: ActiveVehiclePointerTable
compatibility_contracts.description: Global active-vehicle pointer array dword_7C54F0, current-vehicle index dword_7C54E4, vehicle count dword_5C329C, player proximity via dword_7C54E0/dword_7C54DC; slot identity compared at vehicle+0x4894.

compatibility_contracts.name: VehicleRegistryTableLayout
compatibility_contracts.description: Vehicle registry: entry count dword_8AC390, base dword_8AC394, 1060-byte per-entry stride, matched-index cache dword_8AC38C; entries looked up by basename and randomly selected.

compatibility_contracts.name: SerializedStateDispatchOrder
compatibility_contracts.description: SerializedStateExport writes: header dword off_5D2434, header float flt_5D2438, two path strings (null-fallback byte_5EA438), two byte flags, expected count, 104 slot-list entry streams, a byte flag, a linked list, then a range-sum (count, sum, span); success requires expected == serialized count.

compatibility_contracts.name: CollisionSubListInsertionSemantics
compatibility_contracts.description: Collision objects insert into one of four type-tagged sub-lists (this+0x70, 16-byte stride) with node reuse from free lists dword_8AB700/dword_8AB708; 3-bit tag from header >> 29 mapped through the jump table at 0x004B4A10; returns 0 on disabled, validation-failure, or allocation failure.

compatibility_contracts.name: WheelContactParticlePacking
compatibility_contracts.description: Wheel contact surface types gate color/size packing ((value << 24) + 0xFFFFFF) and particle spawning (WheelContactParticleSpawn quad vertices via 0x00558E10); surface type 8 selects the wet/smoke alpha variant, 6 the grass/dirt path.

compatibility_contracts.name: PlayerVehicleIdentityComparison
compatibility_contracts.description: A vehicle is the player when its +0x4894 grid-slot equals the current player vehicle's +18580 slot dword (resolved via dword_7C54F0[dword_7C54E4]); relied on by AI damage, proximity-team recognition, and suspension force computation.

unresolved: CollisionObjectInsert: the fifth/sixth argument semantics of the finalize call (ArithmeticComparison_47a0, 0x004B47A0) are uncertain because v8 (prior tail) is stale on the empty-list path; the a2 header/tag structure and the meaning of type tags 1..6 are not established.
BuildVehicleInstanceLists: flt_5ACD10's proposed EntityActiveDefault role is unconfirmed; the 0x84 field (driver-name vs timestamp) is DERIVED, not proven; a concrete owning class is unknown.

SerializedStateExport: the canonical name conflicts with the observed serialization behavior; the per-slot serializer sub_4B4FB0 and count producer sub_4B5E30 semantics are not visible here; the header values off_5D2434/flt_5D2438 are unconfirmed as version/format markers.
WheelForceAccessor: the object type reached through this+0 and the meaning of the 0xF1C value are not evidenced beyond the single read; there is no null check on the dereferenced pointer.

TimedAudioWithVehicleUpdateDispatch: purpose and argument semantics of the sub_5895A2 sync calls, the meaning of the +12 vehicle-pointer offset passed to sub_4EE2D0, and the a2 semantics for MultiObjectRemove (0x004E3A50) are unknown.
VehicleTypeRangeValidator: the meaning of type identifier 2 and of the accessor value range [6, 8] are caller-domain; the VehicleDataAccessor contract and what this+2 indexes are unresolved.

VehicleNameEnumeration: the string-table stride (1060 bytes) and entry layout at dword_8AC394 are not evidenced; sub_596C80's exact comparison semantics are unproven; the structural twin 0x004C3F80 is not independently verified.
VehicleDataCopy: the semantic content of each byte-block region is not established from this packet; StringCopyWithBufferRealloc's exact signature/destination is not visible inside the function.
RandomVehicleSelector: the register-return contract of BoundsCheckedIndexSetter_6760 (index/list-pointer) is inferred; the 64-bit random state layout and the low/high range check are unconfirmed.

VehicleFrameUpdate: dword_8ACEE0 is listed as read but absent from the raw pseudocode (corpus labels it the force-feedback base); the this+3 and this+3251 substruct contents are undescribed; dword_7C56A4==7 and dword_7C56A8 3/4 are undefined; the 12-byte v9/v8 scratch layout is unknown.
IsPlayerVehicle: the player-side +18580 comparison field has no dedicated evidence ref; the grid-vs-starting-slot equality interpretation is DERIVED.
WheelRenderObjectPerFrameUpdate: flt_59E43C and flt_59E450 are ungrounded; the owner class of a1 is unknown; sub_5881F0's operation is unanalyzed.
ParticleEffectPhysics: flt_59E46C and flt_59ED18 are ungrounded; the per-element particle layout is reachable only by relative byte offsets.
WheelContactParticleSpawn: flt_59E43C/flt_59E440/flt_5ACEBC/flt_5ACEC0 are ungrounded; slot element indices (2/3/24/25) are DERIVED; the a3/a4 corner layout is inferred.

WheelSurfaceContactFriction: the surface-type enum values (6/8) are labeled by prior analysis, not proven here; the (value << 24) + 0xFFFFFF color packing is used verbatim with unverified channel semantics; flt_59E43C/flt_59E920/flt_5ACEBC/flt_5ACEC4/flt_5ACEC8 cannot be grounded here; FAIL_4ce110 carries no semantic signal.

VehicleOccupiedFlagBuilder: the field semantics of the 52 paired flag fields live in the consumer; the occupancy-bit to slot mapping is caller-visible; the four FlagFieldBitManipulation arguments are passed through verbatim.
writeLapCountToVehicle: the destination structure at a2+16436 (0x4034) is caller-supplied; sub_4BC270's contract is inferred; the this[9] lap/threshold meaning is DERIVED.
ApplyToResolvedVehicle: sub_4D1B50's contract (what dword_8ACEE0 holds and what v2 selects) is not visible; SingleFunctionCallWrapper_ad30's action on the resolved element is not visible.

The floating-point globals 0x0059E43C/0x0059E440/0x0059E450/0x0059E46C/0x0059E86C/0x0059E920/0x0059ED18/0x005ACD04/0x005ACD10/0x005ACEBC/0x005ACEC0/0x005ACEC4/0x005ACEC8 and 0x008AB6F0 are attributed by static facts but absent from the raw source of their functions; roles are ungrounded.
The obj-deref bases in WheelForceAccessor (obj+0xF1C) and TimedAudioWithVehicleUpdateDispatch (obj+0xF3C) may be the same vehicle/force owner struct, but the packet does not prove common ownership.
